name: Allied Health
shortDescription: Occupational therapy, physiotherapy and dietetics services tailored to the health, mobility, nutrition and independent-living goals of people with disability.
plainEnglishSummary: If your disability affects everyday activities, mobility or nutrition, DHS Disability Services may provide occupational therapy, physiotherapy or dietetics support tailored to your goals.
audience: People with disability seeking allied health support
People needing occupational therapy for daily living or functional assessment
People seeking physiotherapy for mobility or physical wellbeing
People requiring disability-related nutrition and dietetic support
NDIS participants with relevant Capacity Building funding
availabilityNote: Service availability, appointment location and costs depend on the person's needs, clinician availability and funding arrangements. Disability-related allied health services may be funded through the Improved Health and Wellbeing or Improved Daily Living categories of an eligible NDIS Capacity Building Supports budget.
eligibilityNote: Community Connect cannot confirm eligibility, clinical suitability, funding or appointment availability. Contact DHS Disability Services to discuss which allied health service may be appropriate and whether it can be supported through the person's NDIS plan or another funding arrangement.
